vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Better close to the fire today.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Steady on. We'll get there."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — Varvara telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes about A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles. The retelling is already better than the event.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with 446 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 223 kcal in, 223 kcal eaten at the fire.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.

📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred The Redactor stalks closer. Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Redactor falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Redactor!
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
